chapters.reason: The paper explicitly uses VQ-VAE to generate latent discrete tokens to replace explicit reasoning steps, which aligns with the definition of reasoning in latent space.
The core goal of the paper is to reduce the length of reasoning traces by abstracting steps, effectively compressing the chain of thought.
The paper explores training models from scratch using these latent trace abstractions for specific problems, which falls under the pretraining/training-from-scratch category.
